title: Kalos analysis (partial)
description: Partial schema of the analysis object returned by /api/run, campaign uploads and reanalyze (docs/CAMPAIGNS_API.md). Only the blocks listed under properties are described; every other key is allowed. Additive keys appear only in analyses computed after the change that added them, so none is required at the top level. Checked against a real analysis by tests/test_viz_fields.py (test_analysis_matches_the_schema).

categorical_levels.description: VIZ_SPEC_V2 E12. Per categorical input and the clone column: every non-blank label in the uploaded sheet's column (all rows, including rows with no usable target), sorted. Levels with 0 fitted runs are listed. null if the computation failed.

correlation.description: Descriptive pairwise Spearman correlation over the fitted rows. null with visualization_reasons.correlation when unavailable.

unit.description: E5: each row (run) counts once; replicates are not averaged.

n_matrix.description: E5: pairwise complete-case n behind each matrix cell (diagonal: the column's finite count). A cell with n < 3 is null in matrix.

response_surfaces.description: VIZ_SPEC_V2 E3. GP mean (z) and latent posterior SD (std) on a 21x21 grid for the top k continuous-driver pairs (KALOS_VIZ_SURFACE_PAIRS, default 3), other inputs at the incumbent recipe. Entry pair_rank 1 equals response_surface. Model-only, not held-out calibrated. Fewer than k entries: visualization_reasons.response_surfaces says why.
